row.notes: sprintf into a NeStr: formats with the static CRT vsprintf (options|1) into a 0x200 stack buffer, allocates a refcounted NeStr from g_Ne_DefaultAllocator (or keeps *out when the text is unchanged), releases the old *out, returns the length. The neon UI route actions return their errors through it into a NeStr out-parameter instead of logging them: 'Screen %hs failed to open because of %d' (0x144181e70), 'Failed to find screen %u ...' / '%hs ...' (vtable slot +0x128 of the route-action classes: 0x144189590, 0x14418a070, 0x14418a520, 0x14418c5f0, 0x14418be30, 0x14418c210), "Can't Find Screen with target name [%s]" (0x143888540). Adders call it with 'button_%d'. printf-style format into *out
